title: AFRODEUTSCHE
description: Join AFRODEUTSCHE for two hours of genre-spanning brilliance to start your Saturday right.

title: Radcliffe and Maconie
description: Stuart Maconie presents a feast of great music and chat for weekend breakfast, plus Cabaret Voltaire's Stephen Mallinder shares his 'First, Last and Everything'.

title: The Beth Ditto Show
description: Beth brightens up your Saturday with a healthy dose of tunes, laughs, and caffeine.

title: Jamz Supernova
description: With an uplifting array of alternative R&B, global club sounds and left-field electronica.

title: Gilles Peterson
description: Gilles shares a backstage chat with Brazilian music pioneer Edu Lobo. Plus, Ali Shaheed Muhammad talks about the anniversary of A Tribe Called Quest's Midnight Marauders album.

title: The Craig Charles Funk and Soul Show
description: We're heading to Brooklyn for this week's Trunk of Funk, as Big Crown Records celebrates ten years in business.

title: Don Letts' Culture Clash Radio
description: Don's Saturday night selections cross time, space and genre. This week, he's got culture clash cuts from Zion Train, Suzanne Vega, Joshua Idehen, Jimi Hendrix and Kelis.

title: SHERELLE
description: Jazz-tinged house and techno dominate this show as SHERELLE soundtracks Saturday night.

title: The Sweatbox
description: Pioneering British techno musician Dave Angel brings a deep techno energy to the Sweatbox.

title: 6 Music's Rave Forever
description: Slow down to bask in autumn's cool glow with an ambient hour of down-tempo and melodic electronica.

title: The Morning After Mix
description: Take a moment to decompress with this curated two-hour mix featuring Glen Campbell, Tyler The Creator and Joy Crookes.

title: The Morning After Mix
description: Two hours of relaxing tunes to soundtrack your downtime.

title: AFRODEUTSCHE
description: Want to be part of the morning? Get in touch with the show at AFRODEUTSCHE@bbc.co.uk.

title: Radcliffe and Maconie
description: Stuart Maconie presents a feast of great music and chat for weekend breakfast.

title: Cerys Matthews
description: Cerys hosts a live session from American poet and musician Aja Monet and discusses deciphering ancient scripts with linguistic expert Daniel Harbour.

title: Bobby Friction's Finest Hour
description: Bobby Friction brings his world-spanning, genre-hopping musical taste to Sunday afternoons.

title: Jarvis Cocker
description: Jarvis talks about his Booker Prize judging experience alongside offering some film and gig recommendations. He also takes you along to his annual DJ booking at a Social Club.

title: Mary Anne Hobbs
description: With a borderless spectrum of music, new experiments in storytelling and sound.

title: Stuart Maconie's Freak Zone
description: Stuart's featured album is Dub Housing, the second release from 'the colossi of Rust Belt Avante Garage' Pere Ubu. Plus, Anna Meredith, Philip Glass and the Groundhogs.

title: Dream Time
description: Zakia leads us on another dreamy journey through musical realms, and we head down the Portal with New York singer-songwriter June McDoom.
